title.quote: Approximate minimization of weighted tree automata

extractions.description: This paper investigates the approximate minimization problem for weighted tree automata, focusing on constructing a smaller automaton that recognizes a good approximation of a given weighted tree language. The authors introduce a canonical form for weighted tree automata called singular value tree automata and propose iterative methods to compute this form.
